linkedin:
Consolidation software is priced very differently from vendor to vendor: some charge per company, some by tier, some by number of organisations.

We built a free calculator that compares Joiin, Fathom and Spotlight Reporting for any number of companies (1 to 300), using each vendor's published list prices as of October 2026.

It shows:
→ Monthly cost for each tool
→ Cost per company
→ Which plan or tier applies

There is also a free Excel template for consolidating up to three companies, with eliminations and balance checks.

List prices only: confirm with each vendor before you buy. Link in the first comment.
